summary.headline: Watery Triplicity and Lunar Applications
summary.text: Astrological judgments for a conjunction of the two luminaries in the watery triplicity, with distinct effects in Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces, including rain, winds, ships, travelers, markets, and public affairs. It then explains the Moon’s separation from conjunction or opposition and application to benefic or malefic planets, beginning Saturn’s indications of hardship, illness, cold, dryness, reduced rain, and high prices.
